title: Frontend Developer - PixelForge
text: PixelForge is hiring a Frontend Developer to join our product team in Munich. You'll build and maintain our design system in React and TypeScript, work closely with our Next.js platform team, and help set accessibility standards across the company. We use Jest and Playwright for testing and ship through GitHub Actions. Munich office, hybrid three days a week, relocation support available for the right candidate.

title: Privacy Policy - PixelForge
text: This privacy policy explains how PixelForge collects, uses and protects personal data submitted through our website and job application forms. We process data in accordance with the GDPR and only retain application materials for as long as necessary to evaluate a candidacy. Contact our data protection officer with any questions about how your information is handled.

title: Frontend Engineer - BrightLoop
text: BrightLoop is expanding its frontend team in Munich. You'll own key parts of our customer dashboard, built with React, TypeScript and GraphQL, and collaborate closely with design on a shared component library. We value clean code, automated testing with Jest and Playwright, and thoughtful code review. Office located in central Munich, remote days flexible for the team.
